description.value: Ming's Garden is an established Chinese restaurant on Marine Drive in North Vancouver, serving authentic Cantonese, Szechuan, and Hong Kong-style cuisine in a fully licensed dine-in setting. Located near Capilano Mall with parking available at the rear, it sits on a key arterial route through the North Shore. Touring cyclists will find a solid sit-down meal option with takeout and delivery also available.

address.value: 965 Marine Drive, North Vancouver, BC V7P 1S4
